title: Made an MCP & CLI for my custom AI game engine
author: Virtualeaf
selftext:
Hey guys, I'm deep in building this new awesome tool that allows claude code to truly build everything in the engine. Not just roblox bs.

I'll let claude market my product for me - but i'd love to hear your thoughts and feedback if you want to give it a try! It's still in beta but it's cracked

ps it's free so i guess it's not 'promoting a commercial product'?

https://preview.redd.it/mmh1yk2w0lng1.png?width=2624&format=png&auto=webp&s=602315791de812630ba0853aa269f0997bc2bd4a

comments.author: fisj
comments.body: Aside from the fact that its completely unclear what this is, and claude is glazing you hard, if its not commercial don't add commercial flair. I've corrected this and changed the flair to Demo/Project/Workflow.

comments.author: Virtualeaf
comments.body:
You can ask claude code to create a game by using the [summerengine.com](http://summerengine.com) MCP. And it will have a full game engine that it can natively run and build games in for you   
  
[https://docs.summerengine.com/mcp/overview](https://docs.summerengine.com/mcp/overview)

comments.author: sirpalee
comments.body: Claude is being a bit too generous. Sure, you built some cool tools, but far from unprecedented.

comments.author: GameDevPixel
comments.body:
I would make a change to this project's CLAUDE.md to tone down claude's sycophancy.   
  
[https://www.anthropic.com/research/towards-understanding-sycophancy-in-language-models](https://www.anthropic.com/research/towards-understanding-sycophancy-in-language-models)

If you're going to use these tools you need to understand their problems, especially if you're using them to sell humans on things you made

comments.author: GameDevPixel
comments.body:
Another bit of feedback, you should have lots of screenshots and videos of what your engine is capable of producing.

Compare your text only website with:

[https://www.unrealengine.com/en-US](https://www.unrealengine.com/en-US)  
[https://unity.com/](https://unity.com/)  
[https://godotengine.org/](https://godotengine.org/)

I don't know how you can have a page like this:

[https://www.summerengine.com/summer-vs-unreal](https://www.summerengine.com/summer-vs-unreal)

[https://www.summerengine.com/summer-vs-unity](https://www.summerengine.com/summer-vs-unity)

without comparing the quality of your engine vs unreal or unity, which by the way employ expert graphics researchers and engineers and works directly with hardware vendors and AAA game studios and regularly present at GDC and other major industry conferences. Do you have any white papers about your graphics techniques or engine tech?  
  
 Like you need to way tone down the hype, and actually show what the thing can do.

Sounds like a cool project, I have an open source thing similar to this, for disclosure.

replies.author: Virtualeaf
replies.body: thanks a lot, appreciate the feedback :)

comments.author: Virtualeaf
comments.body: best showcase is the game “don’t pray” on steam which is made 100% in Summer Engine in a bit more than a monh by 2 people
